# Zamin Dekho
India's most trusted PropTech platform for 100% verified lands and farms.

## About Us
Zamin Dekho bridges the trust deficit in Indian real estate by integrating 100m GPS geofencing, local 10-km radius broker verification, and virtual escrow account routing.

## Core Roles & Services
- **Buyers:** Access transparent, title-checked land parcels with digital consent.
- **Sellers:** List properties with zero upfront marketing costs.
- **Verification Brokers:** Local 10-km radius ground intelligence and plot mapping.
- **Dealing Brokers:** Transparent deal execution with automated escrow commission splits.

## Key Features
- 100m GPS Radar Geofencing
- Automated Virtual Escrow Routing
- Title-Checked & Legally Verified Inventory
